sermon.title: Take Away the Stone - March 31, 2024
sermon.speaker: Unidentified speaker (not clearly Pastor Kincer)
sermon.summary: On Easter Sunday the message walks through Jesus’ scourging, shame and death and asks what we will do with it. A new creation requires the new covenant: God forgives and forgets, writes His law on our hearts, and replaces the heart of stone. Like Lazarus four days dead, we are called out by His word, loosed, and brought into a relationship of knowing Him.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: The captions read “Ephesians chapter 24” (Ephesians 2:4-5); shown as chapter 2. A makeover slide (“where’s Stephanie at”) isn’t explained in the audio. The recording places the message first and Easter worship after it (~47:28).
